title: Tilemaps which have scene tiles in, store the tiles connections in the scene file, causing larger than needed file sizes
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.4 stable and 4.5 dev versions

### System information

Godot v4.4.stable - Linux Mint 22.1 (Xia) on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 Ti (nvidia; 550.144.03) - AMD Ryzen 7 5800X 8-Core Processor (16 threads)

### Issue description

When using a Tilemap and a Scene Collection Source, if a tile scene contains a connection within it, to itself or a child node within it, that connection is stored in the parent scene, which is pointless, as that connection is already stored within the instanced scene, which causes a file size which is unecessarily large, especially if these tiles are used multiple times, or have multiple different connections inside.

### Steps to reproduce

- Make a tilemap layer with a scene collection source in the tileset
- have one of the tiles contain a signal connection to itself or another child node inside it
- place the tiles, save the scene
- observe how those tile connections are in the scene file, which is pointless, and doesnt make much sense

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[Signal TileMap Test.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/20758424/Signal.TileMap.Test.zip)
